purpose: Simplify task cards and details, fix the open task review findings, and settle Telegram task delivery.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-11 the owner instructed in the controlling session: "do all. complete all work. merge to main. clean worktrees." after being offered the #426 audit shortlist (https://github.com/netbka/Dyk/issues/426#issuecomment-6107132436) and the open #485 review findings and PR-review follow-ups. Scope: #426 audit items 2, 4 and 5 and the task-related review follow-ups. For audit item 4 the controller recorded the owner's "do all" as option (a): accept Telegram task delivery onto the feature map, add Storybook coverage, and move the Telegram prompt out of the top of Tasks. Basis: the chat instruction from the owner quoted above (given in the controlling session, not recorded on GitHub until the controller posts it on Dyk #426), which explicitly asks for the offered work to be done and merged; the controller treats it as the owner approval that D-040 requires for the audit presentation changes, including removals and the moved prompt. Every visible change is represented in Storybook in the same PR and independently reviewed before merge; bounded repairs also follow Dyk AGENTS.md section 4. PRs only, never merge or deploy; no production access. No limits (owner removed them); provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops. Provider order Claude, Codex, Cursor.

constraints: No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions, paid services, or Playwright and other browser-driven tests (Dyk owner rule). Local disposable SQL only through the repository runners (npm run test:sql / npm run journeys with a selected scope) when a task changes a route or persistence; never the production database.

Keep the affected Storybook stories in sync with every renderer change (Storybook is not post-hoc documentation). RU/EN/HE, true Hebrew RTL, 320/390 widths, 44px hit areas, no horizontal overflow, truthful states (T2).
Never read .env contents, credentials, private conversations or real user data; fixtures are synthetic.
A Storybook build or passing tests is not visual acceptance; each PR lists the story ids for independent visual review and states that the visual verdict is pending.

Do not remove worktrees, delete branches or link another checkout's node_modules. Do not add any new blocking gate, lock, required approval or check that depends on owner-provisioned keys, credentials or setup (Dyk AGENTS.md section 4).
Never weaken an existing test, guard or assertion; never add a capability outside the accepted feature map unless the task names the owner decision that adds it.

Only this campaign edits app/public/task-card.js, app/src/task-board-ui.js, app/public/assistant.js and the Tasks/Assistant stories; other concurrent campaigns own Master/Setup (storybook/src/master-overview.js, design Master stories, setup-view), Chats (chats-page-ui, chat-reader, Chats stories), Tasks/Assistant (task-card, task-board-ui, assistant.js), Profile (profile-page-ui, connection-card-ui) and safety tooling; do not edit their files beyond a one-line import if unavoidable.

tasks.title: Task cards and details: remove the duplicate Edit sheet, clarify the nudge counter, fix review follow-ups
tasks.outcome: Opening a task shows one coherent detail surface with no duplicate editor or unexplained counter, and the open task findings are fixed.
tasks.goal: Read the #426 audit comment (gh api repos/netbka/Dyk/issues/comments/6107132436 --jq .body) and the #475 PR review comments (gh pr view 475 --repo netbka/Dyk --comments). Implement: #426 item 2 (remove or merge the duplicate "Edit task" sheet on /my/tasks so no editor repeats the inline details and no legacy ExtractionPromptName leaks, C2/D-062; keep any unique function such as the personal completion note in the inline details); #426 item 5 (the nudge counter is removed from collapsed cards or given a visible plain meaning); follow-ups: a sender-line separator never ends a wrapped line (HE 320, RU 390), the production-assistant--task-done fixture carries evidence like production, fixture deadlines match their message text, the Completed tab does not group done tasks under Overdue in red, the Assistant "Who is this for?" control is not truncated and is at least 44px at 320, "All saved messages (N)" does not count protected messages, and the review manifest tasks.search entry matches production. Also the noticed J9 gap: if changing a deadline is an accepted capability for members (docs/USER_STORY_MAP.md J9, manifest tasks.deadline), expose the existing due-date control on /my/tasks; otherwise report it.
acceptance: Every listed item is addressed or explicitly reported as not applicable with evidence; affected focused tests, npm run check:ui and npm run storybook:build pass, with exact commands; the PR lists story ids for visual review.

tasks.title: Telegram task delivery: accept onto the feature map, Storybook coverage, move the prompt
tasks.outcome: Telegram task delivery is an accepted, documented feature with Storybook coverage, and its prompt no longer sits at the top of Tasks.
tasks.goal: Owner decision recorded by the controller (2026-10-11, "do all"): #426 audit item 4 option (a). Add Telegram task delivery to the accepted feature map with a new DECISIONS entry citing this campaign and #426, add Storybook coverage of the delivery states that already exist in code, and move the Telegram prompt out of the top of the Tasks board (show it after the first useful result or on Profile/Setup, per the audit). No change to delivery behavior, consent or providers.
acceptance: Every listed item is addressed or explicitly reported as not applicable with evidence; affected focused tests, npm run check:ui and npm run storybook:build pass, with exact commands; the PR lists story ids for visual review.
